lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ren sa(n)tan kee merai mukh laagee ||
lines.translation: I applied the dust of the feet of the Saints to my face.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: duramat binasee kubudh abhaagee ||
lines.translation: My evil-mindedness disappeared, along with my misfortune and false-mindedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: sach ghar bais rahe gun gaae naanak binase kooraa jeeu ||4||11||18||
lines.translation: I sit in the true home of my self; I sing His Glorious Praises. O Nanak, my falsehood has vanished! ||4||11||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਵਡ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: visar naahee evad daate ||
lines.translation: I shall never forget You-You are such a Great Giver!

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa bhagatan sa(n)g raate ||
lines.translation: Please grant Your Grace, and imbue me with the love of devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਏਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dinas rain jiu tudh dhiaaee ehu daan mohi karanaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: If it pleases You, let me meditate on You day and night; please, grant me this gift! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਅੰਧੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maatee a(n)dhee surat samaaee ||
lines.translation: Into this blind clay, You have infused awareness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ਭਲੀਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh deeaa bhaleeaa jaaee ||
lines.translation: Everything, everywhere which You have given is good.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anad binod choj tamaase tudh bhaavai so honaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Bliss, joyful celebrations, wondrous plays and entertainment-whatever pleases You, comes to pass. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis daa ditaa sabh kichh lainaa ||
lines.translation: Everything we receive is a gift from Him

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhateeh a(n)mrit bhojan khaanaa ||
lines.translation: -the thirty-six delicious foods to eat,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਪਵਣਾ ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sej sukhaalee seetal pavanaa sahaj kel ra(n)g karanaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: cozy beds, cooling breezes, peaceful joy and the experience of pleasure. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa budh deejai jit visarahi naahee ||
lines.translation: Give me that state of mind, by which I may not forget You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa mat deejai jit tudh dhiaaee ||
lines.translation: Give me that understanding, by which I may meditate on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas tere gun gaavaa ot naanak gur charanaa jeeu ||4||12||19||
lines.translation: I sing Your Glorious Praises with each and every breath. Nanak takes the Support of the Guru's Feet. ||4||12||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: siphat saalaahan teraa hukam rajaaee ||
lines.translation: To praise You is to follow Your Command and Your Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so giaan dhiaan jo tudh bhaaee ||
lines.translation: That which pleases You is spiritual wisdom and meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਜਪੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਆਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: soee jap jo prabh jeeu bhaavai bhaanai poor giaanaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: That which pleases God is chanting and meditation; to be in harmony with His Will is perfect spiritual wisdom. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam teraa soee gaavai ||
lines.translation: He alone sings Your Ambrosial Naam,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo saahib terai man bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Who is pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sa(n)tan kaa sa(n)t tumaare sa(n)t saahib man maanaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You. The minds of the Saints are attuned to You, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sa(n)tan kee karahi pratipaalaa ||
lines.translation: You cherish and nurture the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t khelahi tum sa(n)g gopaalaa ||
lines.translation: The Saints play with You, O Sustainer of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਖਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: apune sa(n)t tudh khare piaare too sa(n)tan ke praanaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Your Saints are very dear to You. You are the breath of life of the Saints. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: un sa(n)tan kai meraa man kurabaane ||
lines.translation: My mind is a sacrifice to those Saints who know You,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin too(n) jaataa jo tudh man bhaane ||
lines.translation: and are pleasing to Your Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: tin kai sa(n)g sadaa sukh paaiaa har ras naanak tripat aghaanaa jeeu ||4||13||20||
lines.translation: In their company I have found a lasting peace. Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||13||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) jalanidh ham meen tumaare ||
lines.translation: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am Your fish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤਿਖਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa naam boo(n)d ham chaatrik tikhahaare ||
lines.translation: Your Name is the drop of water, and I am a thirsty rainbird.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree aas piaasaa tumaree tum hee sa(n)g man leenaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: You are my hope, and You are my thirst. My mind is absorbed in You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਪੀ ਖੀਰੁ ਅਘਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu baarik pee kheer aghaavai ||
lines.translation: Just as the baby is satisfied by drinking milk,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu niradhan dhan dekh sukh paavai ||
lines.translation: and the poor person is pleased by seeing wealth,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਜਲੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਠੰਢਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: trikhaava(n)t jal peevat tha(n)dhaa tiu har sa(n)g ihu man bheenaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: and the thirsty person is refreshed by drinking cool water, so is this mind drenched with delight in the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu a(n)dhiaarai deepak paragaasaa ||
lines.translation: Just as the darkness is lit up by the lamp,

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharataa chitavat pooran aasaa ||
lines.translation: and the hopes of the wife are fulfilled by thinking about her husband,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mil preetam jiu hot ana(n)daa tiu har ra(n)g man ra(n)geenaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: and people are filled with bliss upon meeting their beloved, so is my mind imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan mo kau har maarag paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Saints have set me upon the Lord's Path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਿਝਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh kripaal har sa(n)g gijhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Holy Saint, I have been attuned to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਮਰਾ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: har hamaraa ham har ke daase naanak sabad guroo sach deenaa jeeu ||4||14||21||
lines.translation: The Lord is mine, and I am the slave of the Lord. O Nanak, the Guru has blessed me with the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||14||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa niramaleeaa ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is eternally pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਡਾਰਨ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaaee dookh bidaaran hareeaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Giver of Peace and the Dispeller of sorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: avar saad chakh sagale dekhe man har ras sabh te meethaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: I have seen and tasted all other flavors, but to my mind, the Subtle Essence of the Lord is the sweetest of all. ||1||
